# A ball: 9 cm across (pixel-art large on a 2 x 1 m table), a 10 x 6 faceted sphere in navy,
# a white spot at each pole (the top and bottom rings) so its rolling shows. Centred on the origin
# (the pivot it rolls about). Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Body --base-color 0.0000 0.1882 0.4392 --no-slot
material new Spot --base-color 1.0000 1.0000 1.0000 --no-slot
add mesh uv-sphere --name Ball --segments 10 --rings 6 --radius 0.045 --location 0 0 0
material assign Body
select Ball
active Ball
mode edit
select face where "abs(pos.z) > 0.034"
material assign Spot
mode object
shade flat
export ball_night.glb
